Software Requirements Specification
“Need Designer name field in WFXSOPackage import file format.
Document # <414946>
Version 1.1 ● 14-04-2026
Contents
1. Current Functionality 2
2. Functional Requirements 4
3. Validation 5

# 1. Current Functionality
Currently, there is a functionality to import sample orders into the system through EDI using the WFXSOPackage. Users fill in the details in a pre-formatted file, upload the file, and the system automatically creates the sample order based on the provided information.

# However, we found an issue: there is no option to specify the designer’s name in the import file format, even though the designer’s name is mandatory while creating the sample order.

# 2. Functional Requirements
The system shall be enhanced to include a mandatory “Designer Name” field in the WFXSOPackage sample order import file format, ensuring that sample orders cannot be created unless a valid designer name is provided and properly mapped during the import process.
